title: Induced EMF magnitude
description: Essential: The answer must state E = BLv.

title: Pulling force power
description: Essential: The answer must state P = (B²L²v²)/R.

title: Joule heat from side ab
description: Essential: The answer must state Q = (B²L³v)/(4R).

title: Force equilibrium reasoning
description: Important: The solution must equate the pulling force to the magnetic force on side ad.

title: Current and resistance use
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Ohm's law (I = E/R) and use the resistance of side ad (R/4).

title: Time interval calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify the time interval as t = L/v for the described motion.

title: Power from force and velocity
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly show the power calculation as P = F * v.

title: Incorrect motional EMF formula
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect formula for motional EMF, such as E = Bv or E = BL²v.

title: Confusing side resistances
description: Pitfall: Using the total resistance R instead of R/4 for the Joule heat in side ab.
